centralRule: The model may help understand, retrieve, compare, and explain. Locally validated knowledge owns exact instructions.

gates.name: frozen_tutor_v1_baseline_and_broad_product_gap_map
gates.note: 332-question library (274 directly curated or source-grounded, 58 labeled paraphrase augmentation) and a gap map that drove knowledge work: it identified 8 high-priority uncovered domains, which curated strategy cards then closed to 0.

gates.name: open_ended_question_contract_and_router
gates.note: 9 question kinds and 100+ domains across 14 groups. TestRunner proves open questions with no Tutor v1 enum match still route and answer, while the nasal fast path still matches.

gates.name: lawful_source_acquisition_and_review_pipeline
gates.note: Review pipeline implemented end to end as subcommands: register-source (rights, tier, handling class, transcript provenance, content hash), extract (candidates enter as machineExtracted and cannot ground an answer), review (promotion records reviewer and date), mark-av-reviewed, and a fail-closed audit wired into make verify. Enforcement verified by exercising the refusal paths: Tier C cannot produce anything but discovery notes, an audiovisual-dependent claim cannot be promoted from a transcript alone, promotion without a reviewer is refused, and the runtime validator rejects a trusted claim resting on an unusable source. BOUNDARY: no network acquisition was performed and no external or YouTube source has been ingested — the pipeline is built and proven, not fed. All shipped knowledge still derives from reviewed artifacts already in the repository.

gates.name: general_production_knowledge_graph_and_retrieval
gates.note: 15 sources, 458 claims, 68 strategies, 12 concepts, 2 preserved contradictions, all provenance-linked to reviewed in-repo artifacts and SHA-256 verified at load. Retrieval is deterministic lexical ranking with typed domain/kind/source filters, per-source diversity caps, and contradiction-aware inclusion. Chosen over embeddings for determinism, locality, inspectability, and zero added dependency.

gates.name: grounded_answer_synthesis_and_exact_instruction_validation
gates.note: Versioned answer contract with strategy options, assumptions, tradeoffs, preservation, stop conditions, sources, and limitations. The validator rejects invented claim/source/concept/procedure IDs, uncited numeric recommendations, forbidden action or hearing claims, undisclosed material contradictions, personal results presented as universal, and overstated audio influence. All proven by adversarial TestRunner checks.

gates.name: adaptive_general_tutor_workflow_and_native_ui
gates.note: Guide Me takes any production question through Ask and renders the validated answer natively: kind and domains, confidence class, direct answer, assumptions, one first move with listen-for and stop rule, ranked strategy cards with tradeoffs and preservation, contradiction disclosures, collapsible detail, sources with evidence class, the audio-influence statement, and the teaching principle. Strategy options backed by a reviewed procedure offer Start guided experiment. Memory controls (remember worked / did not work, per-item forget, delete all learning) are wired to the profile store. Research This is present as an explicitly labeled not-built control rather than being hidden. Verified live in the signed build.

gates.name: personalization_and_confirmed_outcome_memory
gates.note: Bounded checksummed atomic 0600 profile store with credential redaction, size and count bounds, corruption quarantine, per-item forget, delete-all, and a human-readable export. Confirmed-helpful outcomes raise and confirmed-unhelpful outcomes lower a strategy for this user only, bounded so preference reorders results rather than manufacturing relevance. TestRunner proves round-trip, redaction, bounding, quarantine, complete deletion, that a personal result phrased universally is rejected, and that a preferred strategy is not injected into an unrelated question.

gates.name: broad_evaluation_adversarial_and_regression_evidence
gates.note: 518/518 corpus cases pass across 99 domains and all 9 question kinds, including 10 multi-turn conversations (58 turns, evaluated in order) and 20 adversarial cases; 10/10 retrieval precision cases pass with expected and forbidden card IDs. Question library is 518 with 396 directly curated or source-grounded, exceeding the brief thresholds of 500 and 200. Tutor v1 (77/77) and all prior lanes remain green.

gates.name: real_project_and_direct_logic_validation
gates.note: Not startable without the owner. Requires real production-question sessions on the owner's own material plus in-host validation. Everything the engine can prove without a human is now proven; what remains is whether the answers are useful, which only listening can establish.

gates.name: closure_and_vocal_module_v1_handoff
gates.note: Blocked by GP8 alone. All other gates are passed.
